verified_sources.verified_claim: Dataset published 5 July 2026; new files are published on the first Sunday of every month; polygons are downloadable by local authority.

verified_sources.source: HM Land Registry INSPIRE dataset guidance
verified_sources.verified_claim: Polygons show position and indicative extent; each polygon has an INSPIRE ID; a polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files.

verified_sources.source: HM Land Registry Practice Guide 40 supplement 3
verified_sources.verified_claim: Most registered titles use general boundaries; exact legal boundary is rarely identified with precision; no standard tolerance maps a general title-plan boundary to the legal boundary.

verified_sources.source: HM Land Registry Practice Guide 40 supplement 4
verified_sources.verified_claim: A boundary is general unless recorded as determined; determined boundary is the special exact-line case.
Index-map illustrative plans do not define individual title extent and title plans show general position, not exact line.

accuracy_effect: Prevents indicative HMLR polygons, duplicate cross-authority geometries and general boundaries from being promoted as exact legal parcel geometry.
